name: SUNVIEW
recent: Sunview 正在推进以约 RM30.1 million 出售 Winstar Capital 22.44% 股权的交易，首阶段部分已完成，但买方多次要求延长期限。公司同时将 JSNT 收购的完成期限延后至 2027 年。此外，公司已完成第六批也是最后一批私募配售，并有一家子公司获得 RM5 million 银行融资。
notable: 公司以约 RM30.1 million 向多名买方出售 Winstar Capital 22.44% 股权，首阶段部分股份已完成交割。
公司就 JSNT 收购案第二次延后条件满足期限至 2027 年 3 月 31 日，完成日期延至 2027 年 5 月 31 日。
公司完成第六批也是最后一批私募配售，以每股 RM0.333 发行 5,935,910 股新股。
risks: 公司涉及一项重大诉讼，寻求法院批准追回 Labuan 太阳能项目相关款项。
Winstar Capital 股权出售的买方多次要求延长首阶段完成期限。
公司通过私募配售发行新股，可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM104.8 million，环比增长 65.7%，同比增长 62.7%；净利润为 RM95,000，环比下降 6.9%，同比下降 93.2%，净利率为 0.1%。

recent_en: Sunview is progressing with the disposal of a 22.44% stake in Winstar Capital for about RM30.1 million, with part of the first tranche completed but purchasers having requested several extensions. The company also extended the completion deadline for the JSNT acquisition to 2027. Separately, it completed the sixth and final tranche of its private placement, and a subsidiary secured a RM5 million banking facility.
notable_en: The company is disposing of a 22.44% stake in Winstar Capital to several purchasers for about RM30.1 million, with part of the first tranche completed.
The company extended the conditions precedent deadline for the JSNT acquisition to 31 March 2027 and the completion date to 31 May 2027.
The company completed the sixth and final tranche of its private placement, issuing 5,935,910 new shares at RM0.333 each.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation, seeking court approval to recover sums related to a Labuan solar project.
Purchasers of the Winstar Capital stake have requested several extensions for the first tranche completion.
The company issued new shares under a private placement, which may dilute existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM104.8 million, up 65.7% QoQ and 62.7% YoY; net income was RM95,000, down 6.9% QoQ and 93.2% YoY, with a net margin of 0.1%.
